officialTitle: Pilot Testing of the Worldwide Yearly Screening for Hypospadias

arms.label: Male Participants with Repaired Hypospadias
arms.description: * 3-5 Males, age 0-4 (with parental consent) * 3-5 Males, age 5-10 (with parental consent and child assent) * 3-5 Males, age 11-15 (with parental consent and child assent) * 3-5 Males, age 16-20 (with parent consent, child assent until age 18) * 3-5 Males, age 21-65

eligibility.text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Males who have a documented history of repaired hypospadias.
* Age groups targeted, based on recommended standards for user experience data from pilot studies:

  * 3-5 Males, age 0-4 (with parental consent)
  * 3-5 Males, age 5-10 (with parental consent and child assent)
  * 3-5 Males, age 11-15 (with parental consent and child assent)
  * 3-5 Males, age 16-20 (with parent consent, child assent until age 18)
  * 3-5 Males, age 21-65

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
